tasks.name: plan
tasks.title: Plan T01
tasks.prompt: Read demos/agentnexus-acceptance/tasks.json task T01. Produce a short implementation plan: API shape, edge cases, test list. Do not edit files.
acceptance_criteria: Plan names the function signature and error contract
Plan lists at least 2 edge-case tests

tasks.name: implement
tasks.title: Implement T01
tasks.prompt: Implement task T01 from demos/agentnexus-acceptance/tasks.json in demos/agentnexus-acceptance/sample_repo. Run the evidence command python demos/agentnexus-acceptance/verify_baseline.py; all tests must pass. Do not commit to the user's main branch and never write secrets to the diff.
acceptance_criteria: No secret-looking values in the diff

tasks.name: review
tasks.title: Review T01
tasks.prompt: Review the implement stage output for task T01 against demos/agentnexus-acceptance/tasks.json. Run the evidence command yourself, verify the diff stays in sample_repo, and confirm no secret-looking values. Report approve or needs_changes with evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Review cites test output and diff scope
Review states approve or needs_changes explicitly
